message.content:
A vertical rectangular magazine cover features a white background with a red border on the left and bottom. Large black serif letters spell "TEMPO" across the top. Below this, black text reads "14-20 APRIL 2014". At the very top, two headlines are separated by a diagonal line: "KONTRAK KARYA FREEPORT HINGGA 2041" and "BAZNAS ANAK EMAS ZAKAT". 

The central graphic is a thick, jagged red line graph resembling a mountain range. It starts low on the left, peaks sharply, drops, rises slightly, and then plunges again before leveling off on the right. A thin horizontal dotted line intersects the graph at the "27" mark on a left-side vertical axis. 

A woman with black hair, wearing a long-sleeved red shirt, dark pants, and brown sandals, is seated on the far right end of the red line. Her body is angled toward the viewer, and she looks toward the left with an open mouth. Large sans-serif text to her left reads "EFEK PUAN," in red and "EFEK JOKOWI" in black. At the bottom, a barcode, the price "RP 35.000", and publishing details are visible. Blue vertical grid lines span the background.
